ideas.title: Meeting and podcast transcription (market)
ideas.one_liner: Local podcasters and small firms pay per audio hour for clean, timestamped meeting and show transcripts.
steps: Send it free to that show's host
Offer $25 per audio hour for the first episode
Ask hosts for a show-notes credit
first_customers: Google Maps 4-star shops with unanswered reviews
pitfalls: Charge per audio minute, not wall clock
ideas.compliance_note: US: check local business-name registration and sales-tax rules.
